```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)
library(dplyr)
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(shinythemes)
```


```{r}
gapminder<- read_csv("gapminder.csv")
```

```{r}
library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = shinytheme("superhero"),
  
   titlePanel("CO2 Emission For Each Continent Throughout the Years"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("year",
                  label = "choose year",
                  min = 1980,
                  max = 2022,
                  value = 2000,
                  step = 1,
                  sep = "",
                  animate = animationOptions(
                    interval = 200,
                    loop = T,
                    playButton = "play",
                    pauseButton = "pause"
                  ))
    ),
    
    mainPanel (
      leafletOutput("map", height = "500px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    
    map_data <- gapminder %>% 
      filter(year == input$year) 
    
    leaflet(map_data) %>% 
      addProviderTiles("Stadia.AlidadeSmoothDark") %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        lng = ~as.numeric(longitude),
        lat = ~as.numeric(latitude),
        radius = ~2*(Co2_emissions),
        color = "brown",
        fillColor = "tomato", 
        weight = 1
      ) 
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
gapminder %>% 
  select(Co2_emissions)
```
